description: A damp, misty area of the forest. The ground is a soggy mix of lint and liquid rubber. Large, bloated shoelace vines hang from the trees.

sinking_quicksand.onInteract: You watch the slow, hypnotic bubbling of the lint quicksand. Stepping here would surely swallow a shoe whole, so you stay back.
sinking_quicksand.description: A bubbling pool of soft, thick lint quicksand.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A hollow, decaying log. Nothing but damp bark remains inside.
item.onCollect: You reach into a hollow split in the decaying log and pull out a cool, damp Wild Potato!

decaying_log.description: A rotting, moss-covered log lying half-submerged in the marsh.

exit_north.description: The path leads back to the sunlit clearing.

exit_west.description: The path leads west toward the forest exit.

item_vine.onInteract: You touch the vine. It beats with a faint, rhythmic pulse, like a sleeping forest giant's heart.
